pageTitle: Klacks for Security Services | Sites, Patrols & Certifications

hero.titleHtml: Every post staffed. Every certification verified.
hero.subtitle: Klacks staffs sites and patrols without gaps — only with valid certifications and on optimized routes. On-premise, so your operational and client data stays with you.
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacks timeline view for patrols and site staffing
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the app itself is also available in English.

items.title: Many sites, one schedule
items.text: Every site has its own posts, hours, and requirements — keeping track of it all by hand is barely feasible.

items.title: Certifications & permits
items.text: Only staff with a valid permit may take on certain assignments — expired certifications are a real risk.

items.title: Short-notice assignments
items.text: A post falls vacant, a new site comes on board: a replacement has to be lined up within minutes — qualified and available.

solutions.title: How Klacks lightens the load for security services
solutions.subtitle: From a fully staffed post to an optimized patrol — it all works together.

items.title: Sites & posts, gap-free
items.text: Every post across every site — Klacks flags every open slot instantly and fills it automatically on request.

items.title: Certifications checked automatically
items.text: Klacks assigns shifts only to staff with a valid permit — and warns before a certification expires.

items.title: Patrols optimized
items.text: For mobile services, Klacks lays out patrol routes so distances stay short and intervals are met.

items.title: 24/7 rotation
items.text: Day, night, and weekend shifts rotated fairly — with pay premiums and rest periods factored in automatically.

items.title: Klacksy schedules by voice
items.text: “Staff the night shift for the North site” is enough — Klacksy checks certifications and availability.

items.title: Absences replaced in minutes
items.text: If a post falls vacant, Klacks immediately shows qualified, available replacements — without upending the whole schedule.

cta.title: Experience Klacks in your security service
cta.text: Try it in the Playground and see how Klacks handles sites, certifications, and patrols — or install it directly on your own infrastructure. Free, no registration required.
